# Fix render_inner_html to include el.text
import base64

script = b'''with open("markdown/extensions/toc.py", "r") as f:
    content = f.read()

old_func = """def render_inner_html(md: Markdown, elem: etree.Element) -> str:
    \\"""Serialize the inner HTML of an element (children only, not self).\\"""
    parts: list[str] = []
    for child in elem:
        parts.append(md.serializer(child))
    return ''.join(parts)"""

new_func = """def render_inner_html(md: Markdown, elem: etree.Element) -> str:
    \\"""Serialize the inner HTML of an element (text + children, not self).\\"""
    parts: list[str] = []
    if elem.text:
        parts.append(elem.text)
    for child in elem:
        parts.append(md.serializer(child))
    return ''.join(parts)"""

content = content.replace(old_func, new_func)

with open("markdown/extensions/toc.py", "w") as f:
    f.write(content)
print("SUCCESS")
'''

encoded = base64.b64encode(script).decode()
r = await world.call('repo.shell', command=f'echo {encoded} | base64 -d > /tmp/fix_render.py && python3 /tmp/fix_render.py')
print(r['content'])
